newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock fund flows slow in 3-day period - survey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock fund flows slow in 3-day period - survey.

text.p: Cash flows into U.s. stock mutual funds dipped to $909 million for the three-day period ended February 13 compared with $1.2 billion for the two days ended February 10, according to Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

Aggressive growth fund flows dropped to $14 million from $343 million, while growth fund flows fell to $328 million from $467 million, according to the fund tracker. International funds took in $251 million versus $391 million, it reported.

Flows into bond funds rose to $112 million from $50 million, according to Trim Tabs. Corporate/income/global flows changed to outflows of $21 million from inflows of $58 million. Muni funds had inflows of $35 million versus outflows of $52 million.
